Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a leather work apron over a sleeveless fitted top and slim work trousers, gauntlet gloves tucked in the belt — in black with a single crisp white accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — a sudden rain shower or a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small glass jar of rose-red rhodium salt crystals beside a mirror-bright white ring at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: crouched on the balls of her feet, knees bent.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — rhodium: a hard, brilliant silver-white metal that never tarnishes, found in 1804 in the residue of platinum ore after palladium had been drawn out, and named from the Greek for rose because its salts are rose-red; plated over white gold, mirrors and searchlight reflectors it gives the whitest, most lasting shine; one of the rarest precious metals, it has at times cost more than ten times as much as gold, the most expensive metal of all; most of it works unseen inside car catalytic converters, turning the nitrogen oxides of exhaust back into clean nitrogen — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
